tool_args: {"function": "() => { const q = s => document.querySelector(s)?.innerText.trim(); return { title: q('h1'), rating: q('#mm-recipes-review-bar__rating_1-0') || q('.mm-recipes-review-bar__rating'), ratingCount: q('.mm-recipes-review-bar__rating-count'), reviews: q('.mm-recipes-review-bar__comment-count'), details: Array.from(document.querySelectorAll('.mm-recipes-details__item')).map(e=>e.innerText.replace(/\\s+/g,' ').trim()), ingredients: Array.from(document.querySelectorAll('.mm-recipes-structured-ingredients__list-item')).map(e=>e.innerText.replace(/\\s+/g,' ').trim()), steps: Array.from(document.querySelectorAll('#mm-recipes-steps_1-0 ol li p, .mm-recipes-steps__content ol li p')).map(e=>e.innerText.trim()) } }"}

{"function": "async () => { const urls = [\"https://www.allrecipes.com/recipe/229764/easy-vegetarian-spinach-lasagna/\",\"https://www.allrecipes.com/recipe/87173/black-bean-lasagna/\",\"https://www.allrecipes.com/recipe/20082/artichoke-spinach-lasagna/\",\"https://www.allrecipes.com/recipe/23988/simple-spinach-lasagna/\",\"https://www.allrecipes.com/recipe/22729/spinach-lasagna-iii/\",\"https://www.allrecipes.com/recipe/220094/eggplant-lasagna/\",\"https://www.allrecipes.com/recipe/11933/easy-spinach-lasagna-with-white-sauce/\",\"https://www.allrecipes.com/recipe/204052/roasted-butternut-squash-and-garlic-lasagna/\",\"https://www.allrecipes.com/recipe/43926/pesto-polenta-lasagna/\",\"https://www.allrecipes.com/recipe/19354/cheese-lasagna/\"]; const out=[]; for (const u of urls){ try{ const html = await (await fetch(u)).text(); const doc = new DOMParser().parseFromString(html,'text/html'); const ld = JSON.parse(doc.querySelector('script[type=\"application/ld+json\"]').textContent); const r = (Array.isArray(ld)?ld:[ld]).find(x=>(x['@type']||[]).includes?.('Recipe')||x['@type']==='Recipe'); out.push({u, yield:r?.recipeYield, rating:r?.aggregateRating?.ratingValue, ratingCount:r?.aggregateRating?.ratingCount, reviews: doc.querySelector('.mm-recipes-review-bar__comment-count')?.textContent.trim(), servings: Array.from(doc.querySelectorAll('.mm-recipes-details__item')).map(e=>e.textContent.replace(/\\s+/g,' ').trim()).find(t=>t.includes('Servings'))}); }catch(e){out.push({u, err:String(e)})} } return out; }"}

{"function": "async () => { const out=[]; for (const q of [\"https://www.allrecipes.com/search?q=vegetarian+lasagna&offset=24\",\"https://www.allrecipes.com/search?q=veggie+lasagna\",\"https://www.allrecipes.com/search?q=vegetable+lasagna\"]) { const html = await (await fetch(q)).text(); const doc = new DOMParser().parseFromString(html,'text/html'); for (const a of doc.querySelectorAll('a[id^=\"mntl-card-list-card--extendable\"]')) { const t=a.querySelector('.card__title')?.textContent.trim(); const c=a.querySelector('.mntl-recipe-card-meta__rating-count-number')?.textContent.trim(); if(t && c && parseInt(c.replace(/,/g,''))>100) out.push({t, href:a.href, c}); } } return out; }"}

{"function": "async () => { const urls = [\"https://www.allrecipes.com/recipe/21076/easy-four-cheese-lasagna/\",\"https://www.allrecipes.com/recipe/11786/hearty-vegetable-lasagna/\",\"https://www.allrecipes.com/recipe/231072/spinach-lasagna-roll-ups/\",\"https://www.allrecipes.com/recipe/22478/cheesy-vegetable-lasagna/\",\"https://www.allrecipes.com/recipe/172958/no-noodle-zucchini-lasagna/\",\"https://www.allrecipes.com/recipe/73964/summer-lasagna/\",\"https://www.allrecipes.com/recipe/43742/baked-spaghetti-squash-lasagna-style/\",\"https://www.allrecipes.com/recipe/26275/lasagna-spirals/\",\"https://www.allrecipes.com/recipe/14965/baked-fettuccine-lasagna/\"]; const out=[]; for (const u of urls){ try{ const html = await (await fetch(u)).text(); const doc = new DOMParser().parseFromString(html,'text/html'); const ld = JSON.parse(doc.querySelector('script[type=\"application/ld+json\"]').textContent); const r = (Array.isArray(ld)?ld:[ld]).find(x=>(x['@type']||[]).includes?.('Recipe')||x['@type']==='Recipe'); out.push({u, yield:r?.recipeYield, rating:r?.aggregateRating?.ratingValue, ratingCount:r?.aggregateRating?.ratingCount, reviews: doc.querySelector('.mm-recipes-review-bar__comment-count')?.textContent.trim(), meat: /chicken|beef|sausage|pork|turkey|ground/i.test((r?.recipeIngredient||[]).join(' '))}); }catch(e){out.push({u, err:String(e)})} } return out; }"}
